project_name: PROPTO - Society Complaint & Ticket Management App
theme_strategy: Light Theme Default (B2B SaaS Trust & Clarity). Employs Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) for highly functional, data-dense layouts.

rules: No Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
H1 up to text-5xl, H2 text-3xl, tracking-tight for all headings.
Labels and overlines must be Uppercase + text-xs + tracking-[0.2em].
Absolutely NO purple-on-white AI slop. Use precise, technical cyan/blue for AI actions.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for header, overlays, or dropdowns.

layouts.dashboard: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6.
layouts.sidebar: Collapsible left navigation with 1px right border, bg-surface.
layouts.cards: Grid Borders (The Technical Look). Flat backgrounds, 1px subtle border, no shadows. Nesting: child radii <= parent radii.
layouts.login: Split screen layout. 50% form on stark white, 50% lifestyle architectural image with subtle grain.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-md. High contrast. Interaction: hover:bg-slate-800 transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease.
components.tables: Dense rows. Left-aligned data. 1px borders. Highlight row on hover.
components.badges: rounded-full px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium. Use status colors strictly.
components.charts: Use Recharts (via Shadcn if available). Accessible color palettes. Flat tooltips without shadows.
components.timeline: Vertical left-bordered line with dot indicators for ticket history.
components.forms: Use Shadcn components. Solid background inputs, subtle border. Never native inputs.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient + direct layered shadows ONLY for dropdowns/modals. Cards remain flat with borders.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Solid Backgrounds for clinical/functional apps. No Glassmorphism for data tables.
visual_enhancers.micro_interactions: Hover states on all interactive elements. Slight lift (-translate-y-px) on card hover.

icons.rules: Use for functional UI only. Stroke width 1.5 or 2. Do not use AI emojis.

login_hero.description: Modern apartment building exterior in Berlin, representing high-end real estate and society living. Use as 50% screen cover in login.

auth_alt.description: Abstract minimalist concrete architecture. Great for alternative structural visual backgrounds.

accessibility.data_testid: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Format: kebab-case, role-based. Example: data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='ticket-status-badge'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn UI (for .js environment, not .tsx).
Implement Cabinet Grotesk for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body.
Use Archetype 4 (Swiss & High Contrast): Stark black/white base with functional status colors.
Design dense, highly-scannable tables for Ticket and Resident management.
Construct the AI Activity Dashboard to feel like a 'command center' logs view—monospaced fonts for logs, strict grid, avoiding soft/playful AI tropes.
Ensure the Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) review queue uses distinct warning indicators for low-confidence scores.
Incorporate data-testid on every button, link, tab, and card.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭💡) for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable where applicable, except inside dense data tables.
Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use the provided image URLs.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui. Override Shadcn opinionated classes if they clip content.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Follow optical alignment over geometrical alignment.
Contrast ratios must meet APCA or WCAG AA standards (4.5:1 for normal text).
Focus states must have HIGHER contrast than default state.
Grid children MUST be direct children of grid containers.
Avoid fully transparent backgrounds for components with text overlays.
